processing_steps.processing_steps_notes: Processing condition reported as 'Annealed' in Table I; no temperature, time or other annealing parameters are specified for this sample.

structures.overall_structure: Duplex microstructure consisting of austenite and ferrite; classified as an austenite-based duplex steel with austenite as the major phase.

unmapped_findings: Strain hardening exponent n = 0.23 (for the whole range of plastic strain) is reported for this sample in Table I; normal anisotropy factor r̄ is not reported (marked '-' in Table I). [b0066]
This sample appears in Table I as 'Austenite-based duplex' with nominal composition Fe-26Mn-9.7Al-0.54C (wt.%) and processing condition 'Annealed'. [b0066, figure_unlabelled_001]

In the strength-elongation 'banana diagram' (Fig. 9), Fe-Mn-Al-C duplex steels (α + γ) are shown as a class-level envelope at roughly 600-800 MPa UTS and 40-60% total elongation, and Fe-Mn-Al-C steels are listed with a density reduction of 10-20%; this is a category range and not a direct measurement of this sample. [b0052, b0054, figure_009]
